## Context / Problem
The `rebar/host:voter_errors` metric counts every `VOTER_ERROR` twice. `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py::_publish_voter_error_metric` (around lines 111-125) publishes `voter_errors = 1` through boto3 from inside the review-bot container at the moment of the error. Its comment assumes that publish usually fails for lack of credentials, but on the box the container resolves the instance role (metadata hop limit 2), so it succeeds. `infra/scripts/observability.sh` §4 (around lines 960-980) then counts the same journald marker on its next 5-minute run. Each error lands as 2 datapoints, usually in adjacent 5-minute periods.

On 2026-11-21, 2 isolated review timeouts (06:15:50 and 06:35:51 PST, both "review timed out after 1200.0s") made 3 breaching periods, and `rebar-gerrit-voter-errors` (Sum > 0 in 3 of 6 five-minute periods) went to ALARM at 06:36 and 06:51 PST. With the probe's counts alone, only 2 periods breach and neither ALARM occurs. That breaks the calibration set by enstatite-daemonic-tern: a lone timeout that recovers by itself must not page.

`src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py::_publish_artifact_emit_error_metric` has the same pattern for `review_bot_artifact_emit_errors`; whether it double-counts has not been checked.

## Findings before the change
Metric names published by both review-bot code (`put_metric_data` in `src/rebar/review_bot/`) and `infra/scripts/observability.sh`, read from the tree at 39d78c81fd5:
- `voter_errors`: both. `voter.py::_publish_voter_error_metric` and probe §4 (dimensionless). Double-counted.
- `review_bot_merge_change_errors`: both. `voter_merge.py::publish_merge_change_error_metric` publishes it with a `reason` dimension; probe §4c publishes it dimensionless. CloudWatch keeps the two dimension sets as separate streams, so the dimensionless stream that `rebar-review-bot-merge-change-errors` (monitoring_88ab.tf) watches is counted once, but a second, reason-tagged stream exists that no alarm, dashboard or doc reads (grep over infra/, docs/, src/, tests/).
- `review_bot_artifact_emit_errors`: only `artifact_emit.py`. The probe has no `ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR` section and no alarm reads the metric, so it is not double-counted.
- `review_bot_llm_*` token metrics: only `voter.py`; the probe does not publish them.
CloudWatch evidence (1-minute Sum of `rebar/host:voter_errors`, 2026-11-21): the 06:15:50 PST error produced 1 at 06:15 (boto3) and 1 at 06:20 (probe); the 06:35:51 PST error produced 1 at 06:35 and 1 at 06:36. 2 errors, 4 counts.

## Approach
Make the host probe the single publisher for every metric it already counts from a journald marker. The probe reads the marker from the journal with a persisted cursor, so it does not depend on container credentials and cannot be bypassed; the in-container boto3 publish is the redundant path.
1. Delete `_publish_voter_error_metric` from `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py` and its call in `_voter_error`. The `VOTER_ERROR {json}` stderr marker stays exactly as it is; it is the probe's input.
2. Delete `publish_merge_change_error_metric` from `src/rebar/review_bot/voter_merge.py` and its call in `merge_change_error`. The `reason` stays in the `MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR` journal record, so the per-reason breakdown remains available from the journal; no consumer of the reason-tagged CloudWatch stream exists.
3. Keep `_publish_artifact_emit_error_metric` in `artifact_emit.py`: it is the only publisher. Correct its docstring, which claims the host probe is the reliable path when the probe does not count that marker.
4. Keep `_publish_token_usage_metrics`: it is the only publisher of `review_bot_llm_*`.
5. Update the comment on `observability.sh` §4/§4c to say the probe is the only publisher. `infra/terraform/monitoring_s4b.tf` and `monitoring_88ab.tf` already describe the probe as the publisher and stay unchanged (no Terraform change, no apply).
No new config key, env var or flag.

## Scope
- `src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py` — remove the voter_errors boto3 publish.
- `src/rebar/review_bot/voter_merge.py` — remove the merge-change boto3 publish; update docstrings.
- `src/rebar/review_bot/artifact_emit.py` — docstring correction only.
- `infra/scripts/observability.sh` — comment in §4/§4c naming the probe as the single publisher.
- `tests/unit/test_marker_single_emission_f829.py` — drop the stubs for the deleted helpers.
- `tests/unit/test_review_bot_single_metric_publisher.py` — new guard test.

## Testing
- New guard test `tests/unit/test_review_bot_single_metric_publisher.py`: parse every `src/rebar/review_bot/**/*.py` with `ast`, collect each string `MetricName` passed in a `put_metric_data` call (literal names, and f-string prefixes), parse `observability.sh` for every `--metric-name <name>` it publishes, and assert the intersection is empty. Failure/edge cases: a positive self-test on a synthetic module that does publish `voter_errors` proves the scanner detects the overlap (so an empty result is not a blind scanner); a self-test that the probe parser finds `voter_errors` and `review_bot_merge_change_errors` in the real script (so a parsing regression cannot make the intersection trivially empty).
- Existing `tests/unit/test_marker_single_emission_f829.py` keeps asserting exactly 1 anchored marker line per error with and without logging configured.
- `make verify` before push.
- Box check after deploy: 1-minute `voter_errors` datapoints for the next natural `VOTER_ERROR` in the review-bot journal sum to exactly 1. No error is induced.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] [non-codebase] One `VOTER_ERROR` produces exactly 1 count of `voter_errors` in CloudWatch, verified on the box against 1-minute datapoints.
  provenance: environment=prod box i-00880b2c7f13527c5 on 4bf065d8ac4 plus CloudWatch rebar/host us-east-1; principal=frontier AWS profile, agent session 05f74084; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 1-minute Sum of voter_errors 16:15-17:30 PST on 2026-11-22: the natural VOTER_ERROR markers at 16:45:02 and 17:05:03 gave exactly 2 counts, one each at the probe publish minutes 16:48 and 17:08, none at the error minutes
- [x] Only `observability.sh` publishes `voter_errors`.
- [x] `review_bot_artifact_emit_errors` likewise has a single publisher, or a recorded finding shows it is not double-counted.
- [x] A test fails if review-bot code calls `put_metric_data` for a metric that the host probe also publishes.
